title: seedling-imager-controller-display2: control, image-acquisition and image-analysis software and hardware design files for an open-source six-plate infrared seedling imaging robot
description:
Software and hardware design files for the Seedling Imager, an open-source Raspberry Pi 5-based robot that time-lapse images Arabidopsis seedlings on six agar plates under infrared illumination, with programmable germination/photomorphogenesis LEDs and automated experiment scheduling.

The repository contains: (1) the Raspberry Pi controller and image-acquisition/registration software (MIT licence); (2) hardware design files, including STEP models, KiCad boards and bill of materials (CERN-OHL-S v2); and (3) image-analysis-pipeline/, a root-phenotyping package for the imager's time-lapse images (image alignment, nnU-Net segmentation and root system architecture analysis), forked from ChronoRoot2 (GPL-3.0).

This work was supported by the National Science Foundation (MCB-2439581 to S.Y. Bednarek, MCB-2439582 to L. Vidali and MCB-2439580 to M. Rojas-Pierce).
